releaseNotes.headline: A new Modern look

highlights.detail: One ring per AI tool, always on glass at the side of your display. Point at a ring to see every limit, free reset and what the tool is working on.
highlights.title: Full-height rail

highlights.detail: Overview, Usage, Memory, Storage, Branches, Worktrees, and iPhone & Apple Watch each have their own page. Usage shows when each limit resets.
highlights.title: A page for each part

highlights.detail: See the free resets ChatGPT and Claude offer, what each refills, and when it expires.
highlights.title: Free resets

releaseNotes.summary: usAIge now looks and works like a Mac app by default. The rail runs the full height of your display, and the window has a page for each part of the app. Choose Classic in Settings to keep the ocean.
